sloka: यो नः सदा पालयति पिता पुत्रानिवौरसान् ।कथम् रघूणाम् स श्रेष्ठस्त्यक्त्वा नो विपिनम् गतः ॥२-४७-६॥
transliteration: yo naḥ sadā pālayati pitā putrānivaurasān ।katham raghūṇām sa śreṣṭhastyaktvā no vipinam gataḥ ॥2-47-6॥

translations.english: How could he, the best among the kings of Raghu dynasty, who used to protect us as a father protects his own children, go to the forest, abandoning us?
translations.hindi: जो हुम लोगों को अपने निज सन्तानबत्‌ पालते थे, वे रघुकुल- श्रेष्ठ क्यों हमें छोड़ बन को चले गए ?
